name: Idaté
confidence_why: Alcantara's 2015 dissertation on Idaté phonology, with duration measurements, finds penultimate stress in words of light syllables and final stress pulled onto a long final vowel, while the only other source, the 1994 survey sketch by Purwa, Sudiartha, Putra and Widaningsih, calls stress unpredictable and then gives a syllable-count pattern (initial in two- and four-syllable words, final in three-syllable words) without marking vowel length, so the clash is that of a provisional, self-contradicting sketch against a dedicated phonological study.

[ˈmɔ.len] ‘insalubre’ ... uma sílaba leve seria aquela com uma mora e uma sílaba pesada possuiria duas moras, sendo que a coda não contribui para o peso silábico em idaté. Nos exemplos 169, 170, 4 e 171 observamos que se a sílaba é pesada ela atrairá o acento para a última sílaba, independente se tenha coda ou não, sendo o acento final exepcional. Isso indica que o parâmento SQ é fundamental na definição do acento em idaté: 169. [laˈbaːs] ‘ombro’ 170. [maˈʔeːs] ‘medo’ 4. [muː] ‘banana’ 171. [ba. ˈɾiː] ‘levantar, ficar de pé” Foi observado que o idaté não apresenta o contraste entre vogais breves e longas. ... [Conclusão:] O acento pode ser definido como o troquéu moraico. Jakarta: Pusat Pembinaan dan Pengembangan Bahasa, Departemen Pendidikan dan Kebudayaan. xiii+109 pp. (archived copy (Internet Archive, 29 Oct 2025) of repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/3861, 123-page scan with scanned text, 44 MB)
sources.quote: 'Sejauh pengamatan ... panjang pendek, tinggi rendah, dan keras lunaknya bunyi dalam bahasa Idate tidak fonemik. Unsur suprasegmental yang jelas hanyalah tekanan. ... "untuk sementara" tekanan ini dianggap tidak fonemik. Munculnya tekanan ini tidak dapat diramalkan. Tekanan kadang-kadang jatuh pada suku yang pertama, kadang-kadang pada suku yang terakhir. Pada kata yang bersuku tiga, tekanan jatuh pada suku terakhir.' Then: (a) monosyllables tend to be stressed (los, sis, nan, mos, wer); (b) disyllables stressed on the first syllable (hahi, tesi, kilei, mori, kopo); (c) trisyllables stressed o
sources.locator: §3.5 'Unsur Suprasegmental', printed pp. 29-30 (pp. 42-43); restated in Bab V Simpulan, printed p. 78
sources.note: The only other Glottolog-listed description of Idaté and the only independent stress statement (§3.5); needed as a cross-check on a record that rests on a single MA dissertation. downloaded now: partly divergent (trisyllables final, stress 'unpredictable for now'), impressionistic; worth a 'contra/caution' line in the record, not a reclassify.
